lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in roughly five vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming an irregular rectangular grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal alignments of spots, creating a lattice-like configuration where high-intensity blobs serve as primary nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent longitudinal ridge is visible across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel values on the superior edge and lower values (shadow) on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense, localized cluster of small, high-intensity spots is visible in the pre-branchial region, forming a unique radial pattern above the pectoral fin insertion point.
